tweets.text: VIX crashing into expiration on a day with oil spiking and rates spiking is the dealer-flow tell, not a market signal. Heavy short-vol positioning in 0DTE and weekly tenors mechanically suppresses index vol even as cross-asset risk premiums widen. The cleaner read is OVX (oil vol), MOVE (rates vol), and FX vol — those are pricing in the actual tail. VIX rolling off doesn't tell you the underlying risk got smaller.
